lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the intersection of Mountainview and Villa, a massive crater has appeared!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Most curious. This wasn't here this morning.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: I'm afraid the detour would take hours. We must find a way across.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Indeed. Which is why we must approach this logically.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Layton examines the crater, looking for a solution.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Luke, I need you to stay back. This could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: No arguments. I'll find a way across and signal for you to follow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Layton attempts to cross, but the ground gives way!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke hesitates, then runs. Fear overtakes him, and he doesn't look back.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm sorry, Professor... I'm so sorry...
